# Wheelz Business Tools

> Free interactive micro-calculators and unit economics tools for freelancers, agency owners, SaaS founders, creators, and trade contractors.

## Business & Pricing Calculators

- [Wheelz Business Tools Directory](https://wheelzsudo.github.io/tools/): Central filterable hub and directory index for all 10 business micro-calculators.
- [Freelance Rate Calculator](https://wheelzsudo.github.io/calc/): Calculate target hourly and day rates based on desired salary, overhead, and taxes.
- [Rental Property Cash Flow Calculator](https://wheelzsudo.github.io/rentalcalc): Analyze real estate investment cash flow, mortgage payments, and net operating income.
- [Ad Spend & ROAS Calculator](https://wheelzsudo.github.io/adcalc): Model campaign target revenue, break-even ROAS thresholds, and max target CPA.
- [Agency Retainer Pricing Calculator](https://wheelzsudo.github.io/retainercalc): Structure monthly agency retainers based on revenue targets and fulfillment hours.
- [E-Commerce Profit Margin Calculator](https://wheelzsudo.github.io/sourcingcalc): Calculate product unit economics, landed COGS, shipping fees, and net profit per unit.
- [SaaS Churn & LTV Calculator](https://wheelzsudo.github.io/onboardingcalc): Estimate Customer Lifetime Value (LTV), subscriber lifespan, and monthly churn loss.
- [Personal Trainer Rate Calculator](https://wheelzsudo.github.io/fitnesscalc): Calculate fitness session pricing, monthly packages, and client capacity goals.
- [Trade Contractor Job Estimator](https://wheelzsudo.github.io/contractorcalc): Model trade project bids, billable labor totals, and material markups.
- [Podcast Sponsorship Rate Calculator](https://wheelzsudo.github.io/mediakitcalc): Estimate per-episode ad spot rates, sponsorship earnings, and CPM benchmarks.
- [Course Launch Revenue Calculator](https://wheelzsudo.github.io/launchcalc): Model digital product launch earnings, conversion rates, and order bump revenue.
